command: cooperbench run -n coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-flash-flash_10-low-delivery-periodic -s flash_10 -a mini_swe_agent_v2 -m vertex_ai/gemini-3-flash-preview --agent-config configs/variants/delivery_timing_periodic_low.yaml --setting coop -c 10 --backend docker --git
agent_config:
# Counterfactual sweep config: Periodic Delivery Batching (low thinking, gemini-3-flash-preview).
# Tests whether natural workflow boundaries outperform blind periodic every-4-steps batching.
# Pass via: MODEL=vertex_ai/gemini-3-flash-preview AGENT_CONFIG=configs/variants/delivery_timing_periodic_low.yaml RUN_SUFFIX=low-delivery-periodic tools/run.sh coop flash_10 10 --git
agent:
  cost_limit: 40.0
  step_counter: true
  delivery_timing: true
  delivery_max_hold_steps: 4
  delivery_boundary_mode: periodic

model:
  model_kwargs:
    drop_params: true
    thinkingConfig:
      thinkingLevel: low
      includeThoughts: true
